draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.16, the 119th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 10th of 25 at RB. He went 105th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Jaylen Warren. Testing standouts: vertical jump (90th percentile). College production: his final season (2024) ranked 2nd in rushing yards among the 25 RBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the New York Giants. 8 career games and 5 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 5 AV in 2025. Played 8 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-1 running back who played: 617 scrimmage yards against a median of 267, above the norm.
